name: LJ-40 concussion carbine
description: The LJ-40 concussion carbine was a model of short-range blaster carbine produced by Arakyd Industries and available during the Galactic Civil War. It was originally created as a modification of the LJ-50 concussion rifle, then put into production by Arakyd after they learned of its undeniable effectiveness at breaching walls and scattering enemy forces.
